At join the applicant signs a consent and the node pulls a bureau report itself: a tradeline open 24 months, twelve on-time payments, one settled installment loan, even a 40 dollar copper fitting on store credit. The registry hashes the file number, so one report holds one seat.

Aged files are the bottleneck. Two years of payments cannot be faked, and a bought profile still needs real payments after. Fifty clones at several hundred dollars a file pass 15,000 dollars before any burner in the orchard votes.

A dune town shopkeeper runs a tab: goods leave today, trust takes seasons.
